params.body:
Text replies on the phone's voice screen, and agent notices taken from the shared conversation.

- **Text replies:** a switch beside "Mute the microphone". The voice keeps listening but answers in writing, without sound: the live session's output switches to text with `session.update` (`output_modalities: ['text']`), and it can be switched back mid-call. Written answers are kept as the voice's, marked "written". The choice is remembered on that phone (localStorage) and applied when the next conversation opens.
- **Notices:** "Task started" and the done or waiting notices now come from the bridge into the shared conversation, so every device shows them. This page no longer adds its own copy. The voice still says them out loud.

Checked: the suite (only the worktree-only `BuildStampTest` fails), Pint, PHPStan. One new test. Switching a live realtime session from audio to text, and answering in text after the switch, was tried against the model directly.

Goes with portal-cli and portal-android on `workbench/text-replies`.
params.title: Voice screen: text replies, notices from the shared conversation
